overview.summary: UK degrees are shorter than in many countries: most bachelor’s degrees in England take three years and taught master’s degrees usually take one year. The Graduate visa period is being reduced for applications made from 2027.
overview.educationSystem: Universities offer bachelor’s degrees (3 years in England, Wales and Northern Ireland; usually 4 in Scotland), one-year taught master’s degrees and research degrees. Foundation and pathway programmes help students who do not meet direct entry requirements. To study on a Student visa you need a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from a licensed student sponsor.

process: Receive your CAS from a licensed student sponsor.
Take a TB test at an approved clinic.
Make sure funds meet the 28-day rule.
Apply online and pay the fee and Immigration Health Surcharge.
Receive a decision, usually within 3 weeks from outside the UK.

financialEvidence.requirement: Unless exempt, you must show living costs of £1,529 per month for courses in London or £1,171 per month elsewhere, for up to 9 months, plus any unpaid first-year tuition. The money must have been held for 28 consecutive days.

insurance.requirement: The Immigration Health Surcharge, paid with the visa application, gives access to the NHS.

documents: Tuberculosis test certificate (required for applicants from Nepal)
ATAS certificate for some science and engineering postgraduate courses
NOC from Nepal’s Ministry of Education

processingEstimate.value: GOV.UK says you will usually get a decision within 3 weeks when applying from outside the UK. Priority services may be available for an extra fee.
processingEstimate.label: official

duringTerm.value: Up to 20 hours a week in term-time at degree level (10 hours below degree level)
duringTerm.label: official

conditions: Up to 20 hours per week during term-time for degree-level study.
Up to 10 hours per week during term-time below degree level.
Full-time work is allowed outside official term-time (vacations).
You cannot be self-employed, work as a professional sportsperson or fill a permanent full-time role.
Part-time work is not guaranteed and should not be used to plan tuition payments. The 20-hour limit applies to each week, not as an average.

postStudyRoutes.name: Graduate visa

duration.value: 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026; 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027; 3 years for PhD graduates
duration.label: official

postStudyRoutes.conditions: Successfully complete an eligible UK degree while on a Student visa and apply from inside the UK. Fee £937 plus the Immigration Health Surcharge (£1,035 per year). No job offer is needed.

postStudyRoutes.name: Skilled Worker visa
postStudyRoutes.conditions: Requires a job offer from a licensed sponsor at the required skill level and salary. Thresholds have risen in recent years.

postStudyRoutes.name: Settlement
postStudyRoutes.conditions: Not automatic after study. Time on the Graduate visa does not by itself lead to settlement.

lifestyle.text: University halls are popular for the first year; later, most students rent shared houses. Contracts often run 44–51 weeks.
Good buses and trains. Student railcards and city bus passes reduce costs.
Mild and wet. Winters are dark and cool rather than extremely cold.
Paying the Immigration Health Surcharge gives access to the NHS. Register with a local GP when you arrive.
Generally safe. Use licensed taxis late at night and keep your BRP/eVisa details secure.
